description: Mobilized high volume employees overseas on short/long term in accompanied /unaccompanied status. Point of contact from the beginning till the end of expats/Inpat assignment.

Presented company policies, procedures, philosophy, and benefits to new employees.
Managed regions: Nigeria, Chad, Indonesia, Algeria, Canada, Qatar.
Managed the Tax Equalization Program for Expats and inpats.
Collect check payments, verified amounts, and sent to payroll for endorsement.
Provided administrative or secretarial support to a department.
Supported general business operations by providing simply administrative support activities.

matchmaking_summary: The candidate brings extensive experience in Human Resources with a focus on mobilization of employees both domestically and internationally. With skills in SAP database and applicant tracking systems, they have demonstrated strong organizational and administrative capabilities. Their ability to handle complex HR processes efficiently is evident from their roles handling high volumes of employee mobilizations and managing various regions including Germany, Kuwait, Brazil, Australia, Italy, Mexico, China, Zambia, Angola, Nigeria, Chad, Indonesia, Canada, and Qatar. This experience demonstrates a commitment to achieving company goals as well as personal growth through continuous learning and professional development.
